summaries.summary: This class models the Printers screen and related printer management flows in a mobile test automation framework. It extends SmartFlow and provides comprehensive methods for printer discovery, connection, setup, and management operations. The class handles various printer connection methods including WiFi, Ethernet, IP address, and serial number. It includes verification methods for UI elements across multiple printer-related screens, search functionality for finding printers, and complete flows for adding and configuring printers. The class also manages edge cases such as Bluetooth popups, WiFi connectivity issues, empty printer lists, and permission screens. It supports both iOS and Android platforms with platform-specific logic where needed.
